title: One Keyturn Host Payout Account to a Host
content:
A host settles through one Keyturn Host Payout Account and one only, however many vehicles they list, so a second application from a host who already holds an account is a change of deposit details on the account they hold rather than a new account. All of a host's earnings, deductions and reserves meet in that one account, which is what makes the balance the host sees the whole truth of what they are owed. An account that has been closed is not reopened; a host returning to the marketplace opens a fresh account and the closed one stays closed.

## The rule at a glance

| Situation | What the account is | What the balance means |
|---|---|---|
| A host listing one vehicle | The one account they hold | The whole of what they are owed |
| A host listing several vehicles | Still the one account they hold | The whole of what they are owed across every vehicle |
| A host who already holds an account applying again | A change of deposit details on the account held | Unchanged by the application |
| A host returning after closure | A fresh account | The closed account stays closed |

The number of Keyturn Host Payout Accounts a host may hold at any one time is therefore 1.

## Points of judgement

**A host lists a second vehicle and asks where its earnings will settle.** Into the same account, because all of a host's earnings, deductions and reserves meet in that one account.

**A host whose account is closed asks for it back.** A closed account is not reopened; the host opens a fresh Keyturn Host Payout Account and the closed one stays closed.
